assessments.comment: Independent inspection-only assessment of frozen evidence cohort remodnav-e3c6253bced7. No scientific execution, network access, payload acquisition or container build occurred. Historical execution records are reported as historical. Payload absence is not an observed retrieval failure. Scope includes manuscript numerical results and figures, plus explicitly linked computational modules; it consumes deposited raw-gaze and event-label datasets without requiring regeneration from unrelated raw-acquisition source. The report is finished but native completion remains provisional because M-05 and D-01 are null. No peer assessments were consulted.
